Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Tomskoye, Amur Oblast and Pleshkovo are not in the same country because they are in different federal subjects (Amur Oblast vs Altai Krai). This is a logical error; both Amur Oblast and Altai Krai are federal subjects of Russia, meaning both locations are within the same country (Russia). The Planner failed to distinguish between "different regions" and "different countries."
